title: Test guard decisions before the handler
summary: Implement an admin policy that rejects suspended accounts, then design unit and integration cases that prove the guard protects the route.

scenario.briefing: A suspended admin can still write products because the guard checks only the role. The team wants the policy and the route wiring tested.

objectives.description: Implement a guard policy with account-state checks.
Select the unit and integration cases for a guard.

hints: Reject a suspended principal before checking the role.
Allow only the admin role after both checks pass.
Add one integration case that proves the guard is applied to the route.

misconceptions.description: Allowing because the admin path works.
misconceptions.feedback: A guard that allows anonymous requests protects nothing. Deny null principals explicitly.

misconceptions.description: Checking role but not account state.
misconceptions.feedback: Suspension overrides the role. Check the account state before allowing an admin through.

misconceptions.description: Testing only the active admin path.
misconceptions.feedback: The denial branches are the security behavior. A suite that only covers the active admin cannot catch the default-allow or suspended-admin bugs.

sections.title: Test the decision, not the framework
sections.body: A guard decision can be a pure function of the principal. Test anonymous, wrong-role, suspended, and allowed cases without booting Nest.

sections.title: Suspension is not a role
sections.body: A suspended admin still has the admin role but must not pass. The policy needs both the role and the account state.

sections.title: Integration tests prove wiring
sections.body: After the policy is tested, one integration test proves the guard is applied to the route and returns the expected status.

steps.title: Decide whether an admin may activate
steps.prompt: Edit admin-policy.ts. Reject null principals, reject suspended accounts, allow active admins, and reject every other role.
hints: Return principal.role === "admin" as the final decision.
Keep the function pure so it can be tested without Nest.

steps.title: Design the guard tests
steps.prompt: Select every case the guard needs, including the integration check. Leave out cases that bypass the guard.
hints: Cover anonymous, member, suspended admin, and active admin.
Add one test that proves the guard is attached to the route.
Reject tests that bypass the guard and call the handler directly.

cases.label: Returns 401 for a request without a session.
Allows an active admin through to the handler.
Sends a request through the route and asserts that the guard denies before the handler runs.
Only covers the active admin path.
Calls the controller method directly instead of exercising the guard.

steps.explanation: The policy needs anonymous, member, suspended, and active-admin cases. One integration case proves the guard is wired to the route; a happy-path-only suite or a direct controller call skips the behavior under test.

accessibility.summary: The workspace is keyboard accessible. Use the editor with Tab and run checks with Ctrl+Enter; every result is announced in text.
accessibility.keyboardNotes: Tab moves between the editor, hints, and results. Ctrl+Enter runs the checks. Hint buttons reveal one level at a time.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Each check announces its description, pass or fail state, and the missing or forbidden source fragment.
